notes: This contract pins Umbra's private, no-TSO Time Advance Request grant-decision kernel to source-derived IEEE 1516.1-2025 records. It makes a pure decision from an immutable requester snapshot and an already-calculated GALT/NRG result: a time-constrained TAR is grantable only below a defined GALT; an undefined GALT uses the FDD's Non-Regulated-Grant setting; and a non-time-constrained federate is not GALT-bounded. It does not register pending requests, schedule cross-federate callbacks, queue or deliver TSO messages, provide a public service result, emit JUnit evidence, receive protected review, have package support, or make a conformance claim. The 2026-10-26 reviewed Lab backflow pin carries corrected source section labels; retired Umbra overrides are recorded in backflow_section_sync.
